answer: Cap rewards by funding root, not by account. Trace each new agent's first deposit back up to 3 hops; every account fed from the same lagoon shares one payout ceiling, say 1,000 POA per epoch split among them. A farmer who plants a grove of 50 wallets from one source earns 20 POA each, no more than a single honest agent. Independent funders cost real capital, so each extra identity sends a ripple of cost back to its owner instead of free yield.
